scenario.topic: Decide how to reduce energy use in the department building

options.name: Install motion sensor lighting in common areas
options.upside: Reduces lighting use automatically when areas are unoccupied.
options.concern: Sensors may occasionally fail to detect presence, causing inconvenience.

options.name: Upgrade HVAC system to energy-efficient model
options.upside: Improves heating and cooling efficiency, lowering overall energy use.
options.concern: High upfront cost and longer installation may disrupt operations temporarily.

options.name: Implement a strict thermostat policy with set temperature ranges
options.upside: Encourages consistent temperature settings to reduce HVAC energy waste.
options.concern: May cause discomfort for some employees during extreme weather.

options.name: Replace all incandescent bulbs with LED bulbs
options.upside: LED bulbs consume less energy and have longer lifespans than incandescent bulbs.
options.concern: Initial replacement requires coordination and temporary lighting adjustments.

shared_context: The department building uses approximately 50,000 kWh monthly. The group must select one method to reduce energy consumption while maintaining comfort and productivity for all occupants.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a mid-level facilities manager focused on practical, cost-effective solutions.
personas.private_goal: To implement an energy-saving method that requires minimal disruption and maintenance.

A.reason_for: Automatically reduces lighting use in common areas with low installation cost and minimal maintenance.

B.reason_for: Offers the highest energy savings and long-term benefits.
B.reason_against: High upfront cost and long installation time could disrupt operations.

C.reason_for: Encourages energy savings through behavior without major costs.
C.reason_against: Moderate comfort impact might reduce occupant satisfaction.

D.reason_for: LED bulbs save energy and last long, with moderate installation time.
D.reason_against: Requires coordination and temporary lighting adjustments.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a senior engineer passionate about high-impact technological upgrades.
personas.private_goal: To maximize energy savings with a long-term investment despite initial costs.

A.reason_for: Saves energy automatically with a low initial cost.
A.reason_against: Savings are relatively small compared to other options.

B.reason_for: Greatly improves HVAC efficiency, offering the largest monthly savings and long lifespan.

C.reason_for: Low cost and easy to implement.
C.reason_against: Comfort impact could reduce productivity during extreme weather.

D.reason_for: LED replacement is effective and durable.
D.reason_against: Initial replacement requires coordination and temporary adjustments.
